shortDescription: A family safety check for payments and purchases made by voice, with approval before risky ones go ahead.
fullDescription: Second Opinion checks payment and purchase requests made through Alexa+ for scam warning signs, explains the red flags in plain language, pauses risky requests, and asks a trusted family member to approve or deny. Alexa+ can never approve a request itself. You can also ask whether a call, text or email looks like a scam.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Second Opinion if this message is a scam
Alexa, ask Second Opinion to check a payment of two hundred dollars to my pharmacy
Alexa, ask Second Opinion what is waiting for the family to approve

carouselImages.altText: A paused gift-card request with the red flags listed and a family member's approve and deny buttons
